attention.title: Needs attention
attention.dead: Checks that gave up after repeated failures
attention.stale: Published programmes not rechecked in time
attention.pages: Page changes waiting for a person
attention.proposals: Proposed changes waiting for a decision

admin.archiveHelp: Archiving removes the programme from public view and cannot be undone. A reason is required.

rv.manualNote: This change was entered by an administrator from an official page, not found by the automatic check.
rv.proposedByYou: You entered this change, so a different administrator must approve it. You can still reject it.

manual.title: Add a programme
manual.intro: Enter only what the official page states. Leave anything else blank: it will show as "Not confirmed" to the public. Nothing is published until a different administrator approves it.
manual.notice: A different administrator with publishing rights must approve this. You cannot approve your own entry.
manual.noSource: There is no source for hand-entered programmes yet. Register one first.
manual.sourceHint: Links must be on one of the source's approved sites: {hosts}
manual.name: Programme name
manual.benHint: Programmes for organisations are never suggested to individual shop owners.
manual.descriptionHint: Summarise what the official page says. Do not add anything it does not say.
manual.amountHint: Leave blank unless the page states an amount.
manual.infoHint: The official page that states these facts. It must start with https://
manual.statusHint: Choose Open only if the official page says so now.
manual.dateHint: Leave blank when the page gives no date. A blank date is shown as "Not confirmed" and never triggers deadline reminders.
manual.documentsHint: One per line, as the page lists them.
manual.listHint: Separate with commas. Leave blank when the page does not limit it.
manual.rulesHint: Add each condition the page states. The exact words go in "Quote". Use "Note" for conditions that only the agency can assess.
manual.reason: Why this entry or change (what you read and where)
manual.submit: Send for a second person to approve
manual.proposed: Sent. A different administrator must now approve it in the review queue.
manual.current: You are editing the published version {version}. The published version stays as it is until the change is approved.
manual.noProgramme: This programme has no published version to edit.

err.programme_exists: A programme with this name already exists for this source. Edit it instead.
err.duplicate: This same change is already waiting for review.
err.dates_contradict: The opening date is after the closing date.
err.amount_range: The smallest amount is larger than the largest amount.
err.rule: Each condition needs a quote from the page, and a value unless it is a note.
err.hosts: Give one to five site names such as www.example.gov.my.
err.agency: Check the agency code (capital letters, digits or hyphens), name and website.

pc.title: Page changes
pc.intro: The automatic check found that an official page changed. Read the difference, then decide what it means. Nothing here changes a published programme: to update one, add the change by hand.
pc.removed: Lines no longer on the page
pc.noDiff: The text looks the same; only the stored copy differs.
pc.noEvidence: The stored copy of this page is no longer available.

src.title: Sources
src.intro: Only official sources registered here are ever read. Every change to a source needs a second administrator. A failed check never changes a published programme.
src.registerHint: A new source starts switched off. It is switched on later by proposing a change that a second administrator approves.
src.name: Source name
src.hostsHint: One to five site names, one per line, for example www.mitra.gov.my
src.urlsHint: One address per line, each starting with https:// and on an approved site. Leave blank for hand-entered sources.
src.restrictions: Usage limits stated by the source (optional)
src.registered: The source was registered. It is switched off.
src.proposeNote: A different administrator must approve it before it takes effect.
src.proposed: The change was proposed. A different administrator must approve it.
src.pendingTitle: Source changes waiting for a second administrator
src.ownChange: You proposed this change. A different administrator must decide it.

events.candidate_queued: Change found and queued for review
events.programme_missing_from_source: Programme not found on the source page

src.noRecheck: To check a source sooner than its schedule, shorten the interval with a proposed change.
src.recheckQueued: A check has been queued. The next monitoring run will fetch it.
src.recheckNone: No new check was queued (one was already requested in the last 10 minutes).
